stories.title: Katy Approves Zipline Drone Hub, the Only Part Texas Lets It Decide
stories.summary: The Katy City Council voted unanimously on November 9 to allow Zipline to build a drone charging station in the West Ten Business Park. The site will hold six towers serving a 3-mile radius, with deliveries potentially starting in three months.

stories.title: Amazon Wants Kids Inside for Drone Drops. Homewood Says It Wasn't Told
Anne Arundel Police Launch DFR Drone. Their Log Shows No Kings Flights
stories.summary: The Anne Arundel County Police Department was set to begin flying a Drone as First Responder pilot on Wednesday, Nov. 11, from an automated dock near Evergreen Road and Waugh Chapel Way. The department’s public log lists 18 flights labeled as No Kings events, a protest, or a public demonstration on the two days anti-Trump No Kings rallies took place in the county.

stories.title: Asics Says Corvus Drones Find Lost Shoes 60% Faster in Mississippi
stories.summary: Asics America flies Corvus One drones seven times a night in its Byhalia, Mississippi distribution center, recovering misplaced inventory 60% faster. The drones count high-risk areas monthly, allowing Asics to publish full availability feeds and sell stock at full price instead of liquidating it.

stories.title: Nampa Wants Amazon's Drone Flight Data. It Holds the Hub's Permit
stories.summary: The City of Nampa, Idaho, requested flight data from Amazon after Prime Air drones began flying over the city on October 30. Nampa holds the conditional use permit for the launch pad, which its Planning and Zoning Commission approved 6-1 on May 26, and can revoke it if drone noise proves much higher than Amazon represented.

stories.title: Spot Rates Up 50%, Rail Volumes at Highs
stories.summary: FreightWaves SONAR data showed truckload spot rates climbed 52% year over year to $3.56 per mile, while intermodal contract rates rose only 3% to 5%, creating a 30.2% road-to-rail savings advantage. October outbound rail volumes averaged 44,700 units, the highest monthly reading since 2026, before slipping to approximately 43,800 in November due to CSX and BNSF service interruptions.

stories.title: China’s PLA makes counter-drone training compulsory for infantry brigades
stories.summary: The Chinese People’s Liberation Army (PLA) made counter-drone training compulsory for a brigade of the 75th Group Army after an exercise revealed that thermal imaging drones could detect concealed soldiers. The unit introduced new manuals, tactical exercises, and dedicated facilities to detect and disrupt hostile drones.

stories.title: Royal Navy awards Saab GBP15 million contract for autonomous counter-drone radar capability
stories.summary: The Royal Navy awarded Saab a GBP15 million contract for Sea Giraffe 1X radars to integrate into Kraken Technology Group’s K3 Scout uncrewed surface vessel. The system will provide autonomous maritime surveillance and counter-drone capabilities, supporting the protection of naval assets and critical infrastructure as part of Project BEEHIVE.

stories.title: US Marines Turn Counter-Drone VR Goggles Into Suicide Prevention Tool
stories.summary: A US Marine Corps logistics battalion at Camp Pendleton, California, bought 20 OperatorXR virtual reality sets in 2025 for $200,000 to teach its Marines and sailors to hunt down hostile drones. Since July, the same headsets have also run suicide prevention training, and about 350 Marines had been through it by mid-October.

stories.title: Can a Drone Stop an Active Shooter? Brecourt Solutions Thinks So
stories.summary: Brecourt Solutions is developing a drone system that releases rare-earth magnets to jam firearms, targeting the weapon rather than the shooter. CEO Jeff Ross said the tool, which is in the research and development phase, has been tested on AR-style rifles, semi-automatic pistols, and shotguns, and he hopes to offer it to customers by the end of next year.

stories.title: Ring Launches Ring Robotics With Indoor Ring Drone Cam
stories.summary: Ring announced Ring Robotics on November 10, launching the Ring Drone Cam and Ring Rover Cam. The Rover Cam ships in the United States on December 16, 2026, for $999.99, while the Drone Cam ships on January 27, 2027, for $249.99, pending Federal Communications Commission authorization.

stories.title: C-DOT Invites Innovators and Start-ups to Develop Autonomous UAV Payload Handling Systems
stories.summary: C-DOT invites applications from industry partners, technology developers, start-ups and innovators for the development of an Autonomous Payload Handling and Positioning System for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Selected project partner(s) will receive technical development assistance and financial support from C-DOT, subject to the prescribed evaluation and selection process.

stories.title: US rail traffic hits intermodal record as October freight gains signal economic resilience, says AAR
stories.summary: U.S. railroads set an intermodal traffic record in October, with volume rising 9.6% from a year earlier to an average of more than 298,000 containers and trailers per week. The Association of American Railroads said the industry is on course for a new annual record, citing resilient demand despite inflation and higher interest rates.

stories.title: TugVolt autonomous wagons to be trialled on Missouri railway
stories.summary: Intramotev will trial two TugVolt battery-powered autonomous wagons on the 35 km Columbia Terminal Railroad between Centralia and Columbia in Missouri.

stories.title: IAA authorised as Ireland’s Market Surveillance Authority (MSA) for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS)
stories.summary: The Irish Aviation Authority was designated as Ireland’s Market Surveillance Authority for Unmanned Aircraft Systems products under the European Union (Unmanned Aircraft Systems Products) Regulations 2026. The regulations come into operation on 11 January 2027.

stories.title: Memories.ai builds standardized egocentric video pipeline
stories.summary: Memories.ai is building a data pipeline for robotics companies that combines standardized video collection with AI-powered annotation to turn everyday egocentric footage into training data for robots. The San Francisco-based company provides a curated video data lake featuring egocentric video, along with custom annotation services and dataset tools to train robot learning models.

stories.title: Can AI agents program industrial robots without training data? Berkeley says yes
German Military Bans DJI Drones Again After Its 2023 Ban Didn't Stick
stories.summary: The Bundeswehr banned Chinese small drones from its barracks and training grounds with immediate effect, ordering units to stop flying existing models including DJI aircraft. The ministry stated that existing systems will be replaced with German or European products to strengthen self-sufficiency and technological sovereignty.

stories.title: Wheeling & Lake Erie engineers, conductors strike over managers filling crew positions
stories.summary: About 140 engineers and conductors at the Wheeling & Lake Erie Railway went on strike Wednesday, Nov. 11, over the railroad’s use of managers to perform conductors’ work. The union contends the practice violates its collective bargaining agreement and a federal court order dating to 2013.

stories.title: Jaunt and Vertiko Sign LOI for Proposed 10-Drone Cargo Fleet in Canada
Dronecloud makes drone flight notifications free and instant for every UK pilot
Analysis: Flatlining Indonesian high speed rail ridership complicates future expansion plans
stories.summary: Indonesia’s Whoosh high speed line carried 18.2 million passengers in its first three years, but daily ridership has plateaued below initial forecasts. Weak load factors and project debt now complicate plans for route extensions.

stories.title: Future Flight Global Targets Q1 2027 Launch for Florida Regional Air Service
Belgium announces Blue Dome air defence programme with counter-drone capabilities
stories.summary: Belgium unveiled Blue Dome, a short- and medium-range air defence architecture combining radar, missile launchers, and anti-aircraft guns to protect against aerial threats including uncrewed aircraft. The programme includes 14 GM200 MM/C radars, 10 NASAMS launch systems, and 20 Skyranger 30 guns, with first deliveries expected from 2027.

stories.title: Echodyne radar integrated into BAE Systems counter-UAS platform
stories.summary: Echodyne announced on 10 November that its EchoShield radar has been integrated into BAE Systems’ Anti Threat System (BATS). The modular counter-uncrewed aircraft system recently completed live trials in Scotland to demonstrate its ability to identify and respond to drone threats.

stories.title: Allen Control Systems launches directed-energy division focused on counter-drone technologies
stories.summary: Allen Control Systems established a directed-energy division led by Amanda Clark and John Mason to address challenges of detecting, tracking, and engaging fast-moving threats. The company is developing dazzler and 3kW laser variants of its Bullfrog system alongside existing machine gun configurations.

stories.title: NATO selects OSL Technology for counter-UAS marketplace
stories.summary: NATO selected OSL Technology, a Terma company, as one of five suppliers for its new counter-uncrewed aerial systems marketplace, announced on 10 November. The marketplace, launched on 5 November under the Drone Edge initiative, includes 16 solutions and allows Allied nations to procure systems through the NATO catalogue without separate tender processes.

stories.title: The 2026 EU Drone Summit – an urgent, overdue review of the Drone Strategy 2.0
ACSL sees 400% order growth, expands SOTEN pilot training
stories.summary: ACSL is teaming up with the Unmanned Safety Institute (USI) to give North American drone operators a dedicated training and certification program for its SOTEN platform. The new program is expected to become available in late November or early December 2026, with courses offered online and in-person options available for select training levels.

stories.title: Amazon secures landmark drone delivery approval in the UK
stories.summary: Amazon became the first operator worldwide to receive a SAIL 4 Operating Authorization from the UK Civil Aviation Authority, allowing Prime Air to expand drone deliveries to approximately 8,000 households around Darlington, England. The approval permits the MK30 electric drone to fly in densely populated communities, increasing eligible customers from roughly 600 to 8,000 and enabling deliveries of items up to 5 pounds within two hours.

also.title: Amazon's UK Drones Go From 600 to 8,000 Homes. The Circle Didn't Grow

stories.title: UK shared airspace project brings delivery and emergency drones together
stories.summary: ANRA Technologies, Wing, Manna Air Delivery, and Lancashire Fire and Rescue Service completed a drone airspace sharing demonstration in Chorley, Lancashire, with approval from the UK Civil Aviation Authority. The exercise used the ASTM F3548-21 standard to coordinate commercial delivery and emergency flights within the same Temporary Danger Area.

stories.title: Elisa and Sensofusion establish a joint venture to build a privately owned drone detection network
stories.summary: Elisa Corporation and Sensofusion Plc established a joint venture, Masthead Oy, to provide drone detection solutions in Europe. The venture combines Sensofusion’s technology with Elisa’s mobile network infrastructure in Finland and Estonia to support authorities and critical infrastructure operators.

stories.title: EXPLAINED | Ukraine’s ‘Peaky Blinders’ Hunt Russian Drones. What Does It Cost to Defend a City?
stories.summary: Ukraine’s foreign minister asked Washington to speed up deliveries of air-defence interceptors on November 10, the day Russia and Ukraine returned to US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi. Ukrainian officials said Russian attacks overnight into November 10 targeted five major substations, killed two people, and caused outages in six regions.

stories.title: TENCORE’s Autonomous AI KIT Module Enables Over 30% Savings in UGVs - Combat Unit Statistics
stories.summary: TENCORE is moving towards mass production of its AI KIT autonomous module for unmanned ground vehicles, with 210 kits scheduled for delivery. The system enables UGVs to carry out combat missions in conditions of complete communications and navigation denial.

stories.title: CRPF to acquire 'Kamikaze' drone system having 150 kmph full-payload speed with mission range of 15 km
stories.summary: The Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) is planning to acquire a 'Kamikaze' drone system with a minimum operating speed of 150 kmph and a mission range of 15 kilometres. The force has sought technical inputs from manufacturers by November 25, 2026, for a system capable of carrying high-explosive anti-personnel warheads.

stories.title: ARAPL Secures ₹19 Crore Order for Next-Generation Robotic Car Parking Technology
stories.summary: Affordable Robotic and Automation Limited secured an order worth approximately ₹19 crore for its Automated Guided Vehicle-based car parking technology, the largest single order in the company’s AGV car parking business since the commercial launch of the product in September 2026. Relipark intends to offer parking infrastructure under special commercial arrangements for up to 20 qualifying projects by the end of 2027, which may include zero-upfront-investment or cost-neutral models.

stories.title: Are Russian and Ukrainian Drone Strikes Bringing the Baltic States Closer to the Ukraine War?
stories.summary: Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia briefly issued emergency alerts on Wednesday warning residents to seek shelter after unidentified drones entered or threatened their airspace from neighbouring Russia and Belarus. The warnings were later withdrawn, and officials reported no injuries.

stories.title: Baltic nations briefly issue drone alerts as Russia, Ukraine exchange strikes
stories.summary: Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia withdrew drone alerts on Wednesday after activating NATO air defense jets, with Lithuania's warning covering Kaunas, home to about 300,000 people. Finland also adopted and later withdrew temporary airspace and maritime curbs in the eastern Gulf of Finland as a precautionary measure.

stories.title: Agos Signs Series of Contracts with Major Domestic Defense Firms, Expanding Counter-Drone and Defense AI Businesses
stories.summary: Agos signed contracts with major domestic defense firms to supply counter-drone detection systems for overseas weapons exports and develop next-generation defense AI. The AI project runs through January 2028, while the company previously secured its first overseas mobile counter-drone export contract in August.

stories.title: Russia Says It Downed 146 Drones Over Leningrad Region
stories.summary: Russia said it downed 146 drones over the Leningrad region, with Governor Aleksandr Drozdenko stating that counter-action is ongoing. A Ukrainian drone struck the Kirishi refinery, killing one woman, while a fire broke out in the port area of Ust-Luga.

also.title: Estonia issues drone alerts as Ukraine hits Ust-Luga port

stories.title: Air Alerts Declared in Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia Over Drone Sightings
stories.summary: Air alerts were declared in Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia overnight after drones approached from Belarus. NATO fighter jets were scrambled, and operations at Vilnius and Kaunas airports were disrupted, though no drones were shot down.

stories.title: Invisible to radar: China releases video of secret GJ-11 drone striking a target
stories.summary: The Chinese Air Force released CCTV footage of the GJ-11 "Sharp Sword" drone, revealing its internal weapons bays and stealth materials. The video shows the drone destroying a target in cloudy weather, with preparation times ranging from 6 hours to several days.
